query:
SELECT q.value ->> 'idx' AS "idx!: i64", e.event_id, e.event_payload AS "event_payload: sqlx::types::JsonValue"
                FROM flow_configuration_events e
                    JOIN json_each($1) q
                        ON e.flow_type = q.value ->> 'flow_type' AND e.scope_data = q.value ->> 'scope_data'
                ORDER BY e.event_id
